microtheory.name: seven_meta_shape_subsystems
microtheory.definition: L4 composition pattern — the substrate's functional decomposition into seven meta-shape subsystems surfaced by analogical_thinking at n=4 (commit 47b3370 runner-brain design walk). Each subsystem realises one meta-shape across the substrate's OS + brain + control vocabularies: HIERARCHICAL_INVARIANCE_BUILDUP (3078 analogy-weight, primary organising principle), SELECTIVE_GATING (1194, attention + admissibility), GLOBAL_MESSAGE_PASSING (843, cross-Mt comm), PREDICTION_MINUS_OBSERVATION (556, anticipation-correction loop), COMPETITIVE_INHIBITION (452, basin separation), DELAYED_PERSISTENCE (449, consolidation + replay), FEEDBACK_CONTROL (81, homeostatic regulation). This Mt names the 7-subsystem decomposition as the substrate's functional contract.

concepts.name: seven_meta_shape_subsystems_pattern
concepts.definition: The composition pattern. The substrate's functional behavior decomposes into seven subsystems, each realising one meta-shape. The decomposition was surfaced by Jabberwock's own analogical_thinking faculty at n=4 (meta-shape abstraction) — not picked by hand. Each subsystem's meta-shape names what kind of computation it performs abstracted above any specific implementation; concrete implementations can be OS-style (cgroups, ptrace, inode) or brain-style (predictive coding, basal ganglia, hippocampus) or control-style (Kalman innovation, EDF scheduling) — same meta-shape, multiple realisations.

concepts.name: hierarchical_invariance_buildup_subsystem
concepts.definition: Component 1. THE PRIMARY ORGANISING PRINCIPLE (analogy-weight 3078, ~4× the next). Hierarchical processing where each level extracts invariances over the previous level's output. Cortical column hierarchies + cortical_layer architectures + cgroups + process hierarchy + predictive_coding + entorhinal_cortex all realise this shape. Substrate analogue: the Mt nesting + abstraction-by-genlMt traversal IS hierarchical invariance buildup.

concepts.name: selective_gating_subsystem
concepts.definition: Component 2. Selective passage of information based on context. Basal_ganglia direct/indirect pathway + ion_channels + executive_attention + inode permissions + cgroup CPU shares + AVX-512 mask registers (per commit bc4fe5f's hardware analysis) all realise this shape. Substrate analogue: substrate's admissibility check (Γ filtering) IS selective gating.

concepts.name: global_message_passing_subsystem
concepts.definition: Component 3. Broadcast or wide-cast communication between subsystems. Acetylcholine + serotonin (neuromodulatory broadcasts) + VIP_interneuron + ptrace + system_call + vdso all realise this shape. Substrate analogue: substrate's epoch bump (commit f81559e) IS global message passing — single atomic broadcasts state change to all observers.

concepts.name: prediction_minus_observation_subsystem
concepts.definition: Component 4. Anticipation-driven correction. Kalman innovation (y - Cx̂) + reward_prediction_error (dopamine) + cerebellar climbing_fiber + computer_architecture fetch_stage + when_to_deepen_basin all realise this shape. Substrate analogue: the L3 drives_estimation_control pattern's innovation-driven belief update IS prediction minus observation.

concepts.name: competitive_inhibition_subsystem
concepts.definition: Component 5. Winner-take-all + basin separation. Pattern_separation (dentate gyrus) + sparse_coding + perceptual_narrowing + hippocampus + AVX-512 VPMAXUD argmax all realise this shape. Substrate analogue: substrate's basin-selection mechanism IS competitive inhibition.

concepts.name: delayed_persistence_subsystem
concepts.definition: Component 6. Consolidation + replay. Long_term_potentiation + memory_consolidation + memory_replay + episodic_memory + journaling_filesystem + btrfs CoW snapshots all realise this shape. Substrate analogue: substrate's graph_to_dict/from_dict persistence + future btrfs-snapshot-based versioning IS delayed persistence.

concepts.name: feedback_control_subsystem
concepts.definition: Component 7. Homeostatic regulation (analogy-weight 81 — smallest, but distinct meta-shape). Excitation_inhibition_balance + medium_spiny_neuron + load_balancing + PID + cybernetic homeostasis all realise this shape. Substrate analogue: L3 drives_estimation_control's PID corrector IS feedback control.

concepts.name: decomposition_via_analogical_n4
concepts.definition: Component 8 (meta). The 7-subsystem decomposition was not picked by hand — it was produced by Jabberwock's analogical_thinking faculty at n=4 (meta-shape abstraction) walking the OS + brain + control + self_improvement_dynamics Mt vocabularies (commit 9bf8370 + the runner-design walk). The substrate's own data names the decomposition; the pattern Mt makes it explicit.

concepts.name: subsystem_implementation_is_per_context
concepts.definition: Component 9. Each subsystem can be implemented OS-style (kernel primitives) or brain-style (neural-pattern primitives) or control-style (mathematical-controller primitives) per the substrate context. The meta-shape is constant; the implementation is contextual. Substrate's hardware-aware design (commit bc4fe5f) maps subsystems to AVX-512 / btrfs / Arc B580 GPU offload per-subsystem.

concepts.name: subsystem_weights_inform_resource_allocation
concepts.definition: Component 10. Analogy weights from n=4 give a principled ordering — HIERARCHICAL_INVARIANCE_BUILDUP (3078) gets the most resources, FEEDBACK_CONTROL (81) gets the least at design time. Tunable per workload but the substrate's vocabulary-grounded baseline is named.

concepts.name: every_substrate_behavior_decomposes_into_subsystems
concepts.definition: Invariant. Any computation the substrate performs decomposes (possibly approximately) into operations within one or more of the 7 subsystems. If a behavior doesn't decompose, either the behavior isn't substrate-coherent OR the 7-subsystem set is incomplete (which would require re-running analogical_thinking + revising this Mt).

concepts.name: meta_shapes_are_implementation_independent
concepts.definition: Invariant. Each subsystem's meta-shape can be realised by OS-style, brain-style, control-style, or hybrid implementations. The meta-shape is what's invariant; the implementation is variable. Switching implementations (e.g. moving HIERARCHICAL_INVARIANCE from CPU AVX-512 to Arc B580 GPU per workload) must not change the meta-shape.

concepts.name: subsystems_compose_through_named_bridges
concepts.definition: Invariant. Cross-subsystem coordination uses named bridges, not implicit coupling. Examples: GLOBAL_MESSAGE_PASSING bridges all subsystems via epoch broadcasts; PREDICTION_MINUS_OBSERVATION bridges SELECTIVE_GATING + HIERARCHICAL via innovation-driven updates. Without named bridges, subsystem boundaries fade + the decomposition loses analytical value.

concepts.name: primary_subsystem_dominates_resource_baseline
concepts.definition: Invariant. HIERARCHICAL_INVARIANCE_BUILDUP's analogy weight (3078, ~4× the next) is structurally significant — its baseline resource allocation should reflect this. If FEEDBACK_CONTROL (81) is consuming the dominant fraction, that's a sign the substrate is in failure-mode regulation, not normal operation.

concepts.name: tradeoff_subsystem_implementation_choice
concepts.definition: Tradeoff: per subsystem, choose OS-style (familiar, well-tooled, brittle to novel domains) vs brain-style (biologically grounded, robust to noise, harder to debug) vs control-style (mathematically tractable, requires model, fails outside model regime) vs hybrid. Substrate's hardware-aware design (commit bc4fe5f) picks AVX-512 for SELECTIVE_GATING + GPU for batched HIERARCHICAL + CPU for FEEDBACK_CONTROL.

concepts.name: tradeoff_resource_split_across_subsystems
concepts.definition: Tradeoff: equal resource split (no subsystem starved, no subsystem dominant) vs weight-based (HIERARCHICAL gets 4× per analogy weight, others scaled). Substrate picks weight-based with a floor (no subsystem starves below 1% of resources).

concepts.name: tradeoff_subsystem_isolation_vs_coupling
concepts.definition: Tradeoff: tight subsystem isolation (clean boundaries, hard to coordinate) vs loose coupling via named bridges (coordinates well but boundaries fuzz under churn). Substrate picks named-bridge coupling with explicit edge types per bridge.

concepts.name: tradeoff_subsystem_count_seven_vs_other
concepts.definition: Tradeoff: 7 subsystems (Jabberwock's n=4 output) vs more (finer decomposition) vs fewer (coarser, simpler). Substrate picks 7 because it's what the analogical_thinking faculty produced — neither hand-picked nor arbitrary. Adding/removing subsystems requires re-running analogical_thinking + revising this Mt.

concepts.name: substrate_rs_subsystem_realisation_status
concepts.definition: substrate_rs's current subsystem realisation: HIERARCHICAL_INVARIANCE_BUILDUP (partial — Mt nesting + genlMt walks); SELECTIVE_GATING (partial — admissibility check); GLOBAL_MESSAGE_PASSING (yes — gamma_epoch broadcasts via Substrate.gamma_epoch); PREDICTION_MINUS_OBSERVATION (named — Kalman in L3 pattern Mt, not implemented); COMPETITIVE_INHIBITION (partial — basin selection logic); DELAYED_PERSISTENCE (partial — graph_to_dict); FEEDBACK_CONTROL (partial — drive corrections). None fully realised; most partially.

concepts.name: neocortex_six_layer_reference
concepts.definition: The mammalian neocortex's six-layer canonical microcircuit. Hierarchical_invariance_buildup canonical instance + many feedback paths from layer 6 → layer 4 demonstrate prediction-minus-observation at the local circuit level. Reference for the substrate's hierarchical decomposition.

concepts.name: linux_kernel_subsystems_reference
concepts.definition: Linux kernel's subsystem decomposition (VFS, scheduler, MM, network, block, etc.) — different decomposition (~10 subsystems by domain) but same engineering pattern of named subsystems with explicit interfaces. Reference for subsystem-boundary discipline.

concepts.name: brain_lobes_reference
concepts.definition: Brain's lobe decomposition (frontal, parietal, temporal, occipital) — coarser than 7 but each lobe has multiple internal subsystems that match the substrate's 7. Reference for biologically-grounded decomposition (though substrate's 7 are functional, not anatomical).

concepts.name: marrs_three_levels_reference
concepts.definition: David Marr's three-level decomposition (computational / algorithmic / implementational). Orthogonal to substrate's 7 functional subsystems. Each substrate subsystem can be analysed at all three Marr levels independently.

concepts.name: naming_completes_l4_design
concepts.definition: Meta. Before this Mt, L4 existed only as DesignLayer nodes from the runner-design walk + as analogical_thinking output. The 7 subsystems were named but not bound into a composition pattern. This Mt provides the binding + the invariants the decomposition must satisfy.

concepts.name: this_mt_is_consumed_by_l6_coordination
concepts.definition: Meta. L6 (coordination) operates ABOVE L4's subsystems — coordinating across them. The L6 pattern Mt depends on L4's subsystem decomposition existing. Without L4, L6's coordination claim is decoupled from what it's coordinating over.

rules.name: substrate_behavior_must_decompose_into_subsystems
rules.head: Jabberwock introduces a new behaviour
rules.body: the behaviour must be expressible as operations within one or more of the 7 subsystems. If it doesn't decompose, either the behaviour is incoherent OR the subsystem set is incomplete + must be re-derived via analogical_thinking.

rules.name: subsystem_choice_drives_implementation_choice
rules.head: Jabberwock implements computation for a subsystem
rules.body: subsystem identity (its meta-shape) constrains implementation choices to those realising that shape. HIERARCHICAL_INVARIANCE_BUILDUP can be CPU AVX-512 OR GPU OR neural; FEEDBACK_CONTROL stays CPU due to deadline. Per the hardware-aware design choices.

rules.name: cross_subsystem_must_use_named_bridges
rules.head: Jabberwock's computation crosses subsystem boundaries
rules.body: the crossing must go through a named bridge (e.g. gamma_epoch for GLOBAL_MESSAGE_PASSING, innovation for PREDICTION_MINUS_OBSERVATION). Implicit coupling across boundaries is forbidden — it erodes the decomposition's analytical value.

rules.name: primary_subsystem_dominates_by_default
rules.head: Jabberwock allocates resources across subsystems at startup
rules.body: HIERARCHICAL_INVARIANCE_BUILDUP gets the dominant share (~50% baseline) per its 3078 analogy weight. Other subsystems scale by their weights. FEEDBACK_CONTROL (81) gets a floor share. Operating outside this ratio signals abnormal state.

rules.name: subsystem_revision_requires_analogical_rederivation
rules.head: Jabberwock wants to add, remove, or rename a subsystem
rules.body: the revision must be backed by re-running analogical_thinking at n=4 over an updated source-Mt set. Hand-picking subsystems violates the principle that the decomposition is substrate-vocabulary-grounded.

rules.name: meta_shape_invariant_across_implementations
rules.head: Jabberwock switches a subsystem's implementation (e.g. CPU to GPU)
rules.body: the meta-shape behaviour must be preserved. Switching implementation may change throughput + latency + cost; it must not change WHAT computation the subsystem performs (its meta-shape contract).
